parameters.name: ContactGroups
parameters.description: The alert contact group. Separate multiple contact groups with commas (,).

parameters.name: EffectiveInterval
parameters.description: The time period during which the alert rule is effective. Valid values: 00:00-23:59.

parameters.name: EmailSubject
parameters.description: The subject of the alert email.

parameters.name: EventName
parameters.description: The name of the custom event. For information about how to obtain the name, see [DescribeCustomEventAttribute](~~115262~~).

parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the application group. For information about how to obtain the ID, see [DescribeCustomEventAttribute](~~115262~~).

> A value of 0 indicates that the reported custom event does not belong to any application group.

parameters.name: Level
parameters.description:
The alert level. Valid values:
- CRITICAL
- WARN
- INFO

parameters.name: Period
parameters.description: The aggregation period of the monitoring data for the custom event. Unit: seconds. The value must be 60 or a multiple of 60. Default value: 300.

parameters.name: RuleId
parameters.description:
The ID of the alert rule.

> If the alert rule ID already exists, the alert rule is modified. If the alert rule ID does not exist, an alert rule is created.

parameters.name: RuleName
parameters.description: The name of the alert rule.

parameters.name: Webhook
parameters.description: The callback URL to which a POST request is sent when an alert is triggered.
